newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI to seek advisors for Autostrade sale.
newsitem.headline: IRI to seek advisors for Autostrade sale.

text.p: The board of Italy's state industrial holding IRI has formally approved the procedure to seek advisors for the privatisation of its motorway operator unit Autostrade, an IRI statement said.
IRI has said it wants to sell off Autostrade by the end of this year but a regulatory authority for the transport sector, a necessary step ahead of a sell-off, has yet to be created.
The IRI statement issued after a board meeting said it had given the go-ahead for the start of the process to select a global consultant and evaluator for the privatisation.
